         (s : S),
       @PStruct.pstruct E MN (S * A) (S * A) (@eq (S * A))

         (@order.Order.le ssrnum.ring_display
            (ssrnum.Num.POrderedZmodule.Exports.join_Num_POrderedZmodule_between_GRing_Nmodule_and_Order_POrder

     : forall (MN : Type -> Type) (Seed : Type)
         (sample : forall X : Type, MN X -> Seed -> Runner.draw_result X * Seed)
         (A : Type) (n : nat) (t : PTreeDefinition.ptree Sum.void1 MN A)
         (seed : Seed),
       @Runner.run MN Seed sample A (S n) t seed =
